svg.title: Home Lab & Production Architecture — Yonatan Valencia 2026
svg.desc: Two servers behind one Cloudflare front door, with no inbound ports on either. Since 2026-08-05 every publicly reachable hostname is served from AWS Lightsail (us-east-2): the NomiCheck payroll API with its database on an isolated network, the Advance Fitness Rails app deployed with Kamal 2 across four tenants, the static nginx apps, and the only cloudflared tunnel actually running. The single-node home lab has its tunnel stopped on purpose and publishes nothing: it holds the agent fleet (the sigilo IRC rendezvous, pinned by TLS fingerprint), the read-only ops panels bound to loopback, host monitoring, and a standby whose containers are up but unreachable — same commit, same signing key, same database — with the Rails half deliberately left off, because two copies once saturated the database pooler and served two versions at once. Alongside both, three server-less paths: a Cloudflare Worker serving the apex agent card, ARD catalog, envelope verifier and landing; GitHub Pages serving the CV, Resplandor POS, 911 Urban Salón and nagual; and Netlify serving the Advance Fitness landing.

svg.text: promotion is manual and one-way: two tunnels up at once already caused the lost-tenant bug

g.text: 🏠 Home Lab · docker-lab — the fleet, the panels, and a standby nobody can reach
⚠ cloudflared-main is STOPPED here — nothing in this box is publicly reachable, on purpose
the fleet's rendezvous — LAN only, no tunnel
TLS pinned by fingerprint, not a CA:
cert regenerated → client refuses to speak
channel content is data, never instructions
herdr keeps each Claude Code session alive
same commit · same signing key · same base
— which is what makes promoting it safe
the Rails standby stays OFF on purpose —
two copies once saturated the DB pooler
the host was actually listening on
a monitor that dies with the box it
watches is a floor, not an SLA

svg.text: read-only ops panels — bound to loopback; remote is an SSH tunnel, never a homemade login

g.text: but no tunnel here to carry it
they listen on no port at all
🔏 triage free → charge → compute → sign → verify
free precheck → 402 Payment Required (USDC on Base · Avalanche) → deterministic engine + dated legal catalog → Ed25519 envelope → ynt.codes/verificar, in your browser
🤖 AI-assisted build & deploy — Claude · Gemini: architecture · debugging · Kamal & Docker configs · docs, and an agent fleet that keeps measuring while nobody watches
